messages:
ana: Quick sync 1 we have ~28 accounts asking to keep legacy rates past the 60-day grandfather window. Need a recon + billing ops plan.

jess: For exceptions we should create a "legacy_rate_exception" ledger tag, issue one-time credits where needed, and avoid altering historical invoices. Keeps audit simple.

nate: Agree. Implementation notes: add ledger tag + reason, attach approvals id, and emit a reconciliation CSV for finance. Cap credits to invoice amount; carry any remainder as account balance.

rebecca: Vendor corner: any Marketplace SKUs affected? If so we must send adjustments to partners; they don't accept retroactive discounting without a ticket. We'll surface which accounts map to Marketplace SKUs in the CSV.

mike: Analytics ask: please include cohort_label and effective_price_version in the export so we can measure MRR impact of exceptions. Also include renewal_date and commit_type.

sandeep: Engineering: will add X-Redwood-Price-Version header and expose an endpoint /v1/billing/recon/export that emits reconciled rows with price_version, ledger_tag, and approval_id. Estimate 1 engineer-day.

jess: Support playbook: short macro explaining exception, credit timing, and how it shows on next invoice. I'll draft and post in #support-desk.

billing-bot: Reminder: billing calendar lock 2026-06-10 22:00 UTC. Submissions for recon must be before lock to affect next cycle.

ana: Action list: 1) ledger tag + credits flow doc (jess + nate)  Thu EOD. 2) vendor Marketplace mapping (rebecca)  Wed. 3) eng export + header (sandeep)  PR by Tue. 4) analytics fields in export (mike)  Mon. 5) support macro (jess)  Fri.

mike: noted. i'll add dashboard rows for exception cohort.

ana: Thanks all. If any edge-case (annual prepay negative invoice) surfaces, escalate to ops; we'll hold the rollout for that account until reconciled.
